tests.name: Engine smoke, Helix Native
tests.checks: Native loads a known preset and renders a 2 s clean guitar clip
tests.key_result: renders cleanly: peak -13.8 dBFS, 0.17 s per render
tests.pass_rule: length right, no invalid values, peak between -30 and -1 dBFS, at least 20 dB above the noise floor

tests.name: Engine smoke, HX Stomp
tests.checks: The pedal loads the same preset, renders the clip, and is put back on its own preset
tests.key_result: renders cleanly: peak -13.5 dBFS, 2.66 s per render
tests.pass_rule: same checks as Native, health check passes, original preset restored

tests.name: Hardware parity (null test)
tests.checks: Same clean guitar clip and presets K, A, B0, B00 and BT0 through the Stomp and Native, aligned, level-matched and subtracted
tests.key_result: null (dB, lower is closer): K -31.0, A -30.9, B0 -37.1, B00 -39.7; delay-tail level, Stomp minus Native +1.3 dB; pedal restored byte for byte
tests.pass_rule: null at or below -30 dB for K, A, B0 and B00; delay tail (BT0) level within 2 dB; 04C restored and byte-diffed

tests.name: Loss trust check (proxy)
tests.checks: Does each scoring method rank the true setup first among 15 decoys? On stand-in digital effects, not Helix, because the Helix set is not rendered
tests.key_result: best held-out rank-1 0.28 (provisional_sum) over 40 items; chance 0.062; combined score 0.28 vs the 0.95 needed on real Helix audio: not trusted yet
tests.pass_rule: no method's held-out rank-1 falls more than 0.05 below the previous run (seeds 9301, 9302); the 0.90 / 0.95 admission rule needs Helix audio
